name: Amvel Soursop-Saffron Cream
description: A premium cream soda using real soursop pulp and genuine saffron infusion — one of the most expensive non-Spire sodas on the M88 market. Sold in 200ml amber glass bottles with a wax-sealed cap, marketed as an occasion drink.
flavor_profile: Lush, creamy soursop — like custard and pineapple merged — with saffron's honeyed, slightly metallic floral warmth underneath; vanilla-cream carbonation softens everything into a rich, dessert-like experience
cultural_context: Amvel is a gift drink — you bring a bottle to a dinner party, not a meal; the amber glass bottle is often kept as a decorative object after consumption; in Tier 3, owning Amvel signals aspiration; in Tier 4, it's casual but appreciated.
story_hooks: A counterfeit Amvel operation is running in the Midden — the fakes are convincing enough to pass at Tier 3 dinner tables, and the real Amvel company is furious but can't locate the source.
An Amvel bottle was used to deliver a message to a Tier 4 executive — the note inside referred to events that should have been classified at the corponation level, and now the executive is missing.
The saffron in Amvel comes from a vertical farm collective that is secretly run by a banned political organization; Amvel's board doesn't know, or claims not to know.
